links.outcome: Internal versus external validation AUC for detecting middle ear disease on otoscopic images
links.effect: Mean internal AUC 0.95 (95%CI 0.80-1.00) versus external AUC 0.76 (95%CI 0.61-0.91); mean difference -0.19, p ≤ 0.04.
links.quote: Overall, external performance was significantly lower than internal performance (mean difference in AUC: -0.19, p ≤ 0.04).

links.outcome: Performance across three sites (Turkey, Chile, USA) when tested on external cohorts
links.effect: External performance across independent site cohorts dropped to mean AUC 0.76 from internal 0.95.
links.quote: However, performance was reduced when tested on external otoscopic images not used for training (mean AUC: 0.76, 95%CI: 0.61-0.91).

unlisted_practices: Pooling data from multiple cohorts for training to improve generalizability (pooled AUC 0.96)

screen.reason: Empirically tests the generalizability of deep learning otoscopy algorithms by comparing internal validation vs multi-site external validation across distinct geographical cohorts.
